text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—Cooldown complete. That wraps up this 
morning's training session.
choice_data_list: Let's try a new routine this afternoon!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. I shall face it with all my 
might. Well then, see you after school.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Y-You've got quite an intense workout item 
again... This... 'bag with iron plates 
inside.' Just holding it like this is 
taking everything I've got...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I've been focusing especially on strength 
training lately. Of course, there is no 
need to worry about injuries. Managing the 
workload is—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Trainer is doing it for me.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *phew*... Duramente, you can 
still keep dancing...~?!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Relaxing your shoulders reduces both 
fatigue and stiffness. That's advice from 
my Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, a perfect score on the test! With 
all that training, where did they even 
find the time...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"She's focused on class. To help with 
that, the Trainer took care of the 
cool-down—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, no. It's practically become 
Duramente's catchphrase, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Your Trainer seems like a really nice 
person.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Warm-up complete. Well then—... I'm 
counting on you this afternoon too, 
Trainer.
